title: feat(auth)!: refuse to boot multi-replica without an explicit OS_AUTH_SECRET (#3814 F3e)
body:
epic:#3814#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BrVu5TqwtmuhsjdEvM
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-dispatched task (child of #3814). Maintainer, (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「继续，现在派第二批」 (gate 1 after the card 0 inventory, cloud#3868 comment 6723322368).

Parent: #3814 (rulings R0-R6 on comment 6722625146).

## Problem (smoke, card 0)
With `OS_SECRET_KEY` set but no `OS_AUTH_SECRET`, a third replica booted and minted `/data/auth-secret` on its own volume; the session cookie from r1 was `UNAUTHENTICATED` on r3. `OS_SECRET_KEY` is already refused when missing (LocalCryptoProvider); the auth secret is not. The kit's install.sh and the Helm secret carry it, so only hand-rolled deploys are exposed.

## Do
1. When replicas>1 is declared on the Redis driver and `OS_AUTH_SECRET` is unset, refuse the boot with one line naming the variable and how to generate it, mirroring the data-key refusal.
2. Single node keeps auto-minting exactly as today.
3. Tests: declared multi-replica + Redis + no auth secret = refused with the message; single node = minted as today.

## Rules that bind every #3814 child (verbatim rulings on the parent)
R1 peer round-robin. R2 Redis required for multi-replica only. R3 「同意：每张卡都只在"声明多副本并接上 Redis 驱动"时才生效」: the single-node default path is unchanged, multi-replica behaviour switches on only behind declared replicas>1 AND a connected Redis cluster driver, the split-brain guard is never weakened, and the deploy README "multi-node unsupported" line stays until the final gate.

## Done when
PR merged; a multi-replica boot without the auth secret refuses; single node unchanged.
